pure-announcement.rationale: It accompanies a vendor model release, but it is a technical report whose idea — orchestrator LLMs trained to devise query-adaptive agentic scaffolds — transfers beyond the Fugu products, so it is not solely an announcement.

duplicate.rationale: No supplied existing concept covers orchestrator models or agentic scaffolds; the overlapping material sits in sibling staging notes (Conductor, Trinity) from the same group, not in the corpus.

unfalsifiable.rationale: Claims trace to a primary arXiv technical report naming public benchmarks (SWE-Bench Pro, GPQA-Diamond, etc.) a reader can check.

durability.rationale: The abstract's substance is product-shaped — two named model SKUs and SOTA claims across a benchmark list that will be surpassed well within a year — while its durable mechanism content largely restates the group's Conductor and Trinity papers.

actionability.rationale: The concrete step a reader can take is to use the Fugu models — a product-only action — since replicating the training paradigm requires frontier-lab fine-tuning, evolutionary, and RL infrastructure.

atomicity.rationale: Training paradigm, infrastructure, and release all cohere around one idea — an orchestrator model family that builds adaptive scaffolds over an agent team — statable in a paragraph.
